review:
R.I.P. City is a 5x5 cartoon slapstick slot starring Ro$$ the Cat and Maxx the Mouse. The Wild Cat symbol can drop down into an expanding wild that may cover its whole reel. If it swallows a regular wild on the way, that wild's multiplier transfers to the whole expanded cat.

The Ro$$ bonus gives more Wild Cats, and the higher tier is where multipliers stack up. It's a playful setup with a clear goal: you want long expanded cats eating multiplier wilds. The maximum is 12,500x. Later games such as Rad Maxx and Hot Ross build on the same characters.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.02% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
